description.en: Enables or disables the match AI for a single character, looked up by team slot and character ID or number — the per-character counterpart to CMND_BTL_STOP_AI.
True to stop/disable the character's AI, false to resume it.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Optional character ID string (hashed via CRC32) identifying which member to affect; only read when at least 3 arguments are given.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
